{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy shielding''' was an enhancement that increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against energy damage, to a similar degree as the [[armorweave underlay]]. The Mark I, II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can be used with all types of armor.
